description: This file implements compression and decompression utilities for WebSocket compression, including pooling of flate readers and writers, and handling of compression levels.

classes.name: truncWriter
classes.description: An io.Writer that writes all but the last four bytes of the stream to another io.Writer.

classes.name: flateWriteWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper around flate.Writer that manages flushing and closing.

classes.name: flateReadWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper around io.ReadCloser for flate.Reader that handles pooling and EOF.

methods.name: decompressNoContextTakeover
methods.description: Decompresses data with no context takeover, adding RFC-specified tail bytes.

methods.name: isValidCompressionLevel
methods.description: Checks if a given compression level is within valid bounds.

methods.name: compressNoContextTakeover
methods.description: Compresses data with no context takeover, using pooled flate writers.
